title: Poverty & equality categories
story: As a user, I want Poverty Reduction and Income Equality scores so I can judge distributional effects.
description: Score Poverty Reduction and Income Equality from the lever mix and outputs. Value-laden notions of 'fairness' are expressed via configurable weighting profiles (US-007), not baked into category scores.
acceptance_criteria: Rationale explains which levers/outcomes drove the score
